name: Kanojo no Okaimono ~2LDK Pet Tsuki~
original_name: 彼女のお飼い者～2LDKペット付～
source:
Main character has his apartment burnt down. He meets a senior company female employee who agrees to give him shelter if agrees to become her dog and server. Protagonist repeats sex with her aiming to reverse positions.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-may-2005-princess-witches.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公的公寓遭遇火灾。他遇见公司的一名女性前辈，对方同意收留他，条件是他必须成为她的狗和仆人。主人公不断与她发生关系，试图最终逆转两人的主从地位。
